appaṭirūpa：အ-ပ္ပဋိရူပ（တိ）

DOP: paṭirūpa, patirūpa mfn. and m. [ S. pratirūpa], 1. ( mfn. ) fitting, proper, suitable; corresponding; (what is) proper, fitting; Abh 715 (~o ’nucchavikam); Vin I 347, 8 (na kho m’ etaṃ ~aṃ yo ’haṃ pitu vacanaṃ atikkameyyan ti); II 166, 3 (anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānassa ~aṃ seyyaṃ dātun ti); D II 30, 16 (na kho m’ etaṃ ~aṃ yo ’haṃ ākiṇṇo viharāmi, yannūnāhaṃ eko gaṇasmā vūpakaṭṭho vihareyyan ti); III 189, 12 (mātāpitaro … puttaṃ … sippaṃ sikkhāpenti ~ena dārena saṃyojenti); M III 264, 17 (sace āyasmato Channassa natthi ~o upaṭṭhāko ahaṃ āyasmantaṃ Channaṃ upaṭṭhahissāmi); S I 111, 18* (n’ etaṃ tava ~aṃ yad aññaṃ anusāsasi); A II 32, 12* (~e vase dese); Dhp 158 (attānam eva paṭhamaṃ ~e nivesaye; Dhp-a III 142, 1 foll.: anucchavike guṇe patiṭṭhāpeyya); Pv 24:14 (n’ etaṃ channaṃ na ~aṃ yaṃ tvaṃ aticarāsi maṃ); Th 588 (sussūsā ca garūnaṃ etaṃ samaṇassa ~aṃ); Ja I 381, 35 foll. (gihīnaṃ nāma rājantepure dhammaṃ desetuṃ vā vācetuṃ vā na ~aṃ ayyānam eva ~an ti); 452, 3 (āvāhavivāhasambandho nāma mayhaṃ tayā tuyhaṃ ca mayā saddhiṃ ~o); IV 10, 4* (etasmiṃ te sulapite ~e subhāsite); V 99, 7 (ṭhapetvā maṃ añño rājānaṃ ~e nivesetuṃ samattho nāma natthi); VI 266, 16* (~aṃ paṭipajja suṅkiyaṃ; 266, 22´ : attano kulapadesānurūpaṃ dhītu suṅkaṃ dhanaṃ paṭipajja gaṇha); Nidd I 132, 19 (etaṃ channaṃ etaṃ ~aṃ etaṃ anucchavikaṃ etaṃ anulomaṃ); Mil 358, 13 (puggalo yutto patto anucchaviko araho ~o appiccho santuṭṭho …) Vism 73, 24 (paṃsukūlikādibhāvo pi c’ assa ~o hotī ti); Sp 1133, 6 (nālan ti na ~o na yutto upaṭṭhātuṃ); 1364, 7 (attano ~aṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā); Ud-a 106, 17 (evaṃ sannipatitānaṃ pabbajitānaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ paṭikkhipitvā idāni nesaṃ ~aṃ paṭipattiṃ anujānanto, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee omit ~aṃ); Ap-a 210, 37 (thero pi laddhapiṇḍapāto paribhuñjituṃ ~aṃ okāsaṃ gato); — ifc see gihi- ( sv gih[(n] ); — 2. ( m. and mfn. ) (being) a falsified representation; a counterfeit; Sn 89 (chadanaṃ katvāna subbatānaṃ … ~ena caraṃ sa maggadūsī; Pj II 164, 25 : chadanaṃ katvā ti ~aṃ karitvā vesaṃ gahetvā liṅgaṃ dhāretvā ti attho; 165, 24 : ~ena yuttarūpena bāhiramaṭṭhena ācārena caraṃ); Pj II 289, 8 (te hi yasmā nesaṃ iriyāpathasampadādīhi sīlavantapaṭirūpam atthi tasmā ~ā, ~ā eva pāṭirupikā, Be, Se so; Ce sīlavantapaṭirūpatā; Ee nesaṃ iriyāpathasampadādisīlabbataṃ ~aṃ atthi tasmā paṭirūpikā, paṭirupikā eva pāṭirūpikā); Pv-a 211, 21 (nikativañcanāya cā ti nikatiyā vañcanāya ca, °-dassanena paresaṃ vikārena vañcanāya ca); — ifc see mitta-; — °- desavāsa , m. , living in a suitable region; D III 276, 6 (cattāri cakkāni ~o sappurisūpassayo attasammāpaṇidhi pubbe ca katapuññatā, ime cattāro dhammā bahukārā; Sv 1058, 27 foll.: yattha catasso parisā sandissanti evarūpe anucchavike dese vāso); Khp 5:3; Peṭ 129, 14 ; Nett 29, 16 ; Mil 93, 20 ; Pj I 132, 4 foll.; — appaṭirūpa , appatirūpa , mfn. , not fitting; not suitable; Vin III 20, 19 (vigarahi buddho bhagavā ananucchaviyaṃ moghapurisa ananulomikaṃ ~aṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ; Sp 219, 29 : ananulomikattā eva ca ~aṃ, paṭirūpaṃ sadisaṃ paṭibhāgaṃ na hoti); D III 224, 25 (na ca cīvarahetu anesanaṃ ~aṃ āpajjati); Ja IV 306, 9 (pabbajitānaṃ evaṃ loluppavasena phalāphalass’ atthāya vicaraṇaṃ nāma ~aṃ); Mil 357, 10 (puggalo … anaraho ~o dhutaṅgaṃ samādiyati); Vism 305, 5 (paṭighacittaṃ nāma uppādetuṃ ativiya ayuttaṃ ~an ti); Ps III 150, 24 (~aṃ mayā kataṃ); Mp I 458, 4 (paresaṃ gehe gabbhavuṭṭhānaṃ nāma ~an ti).
CPD: a-ppaṭirūpa ( or appatirūpa) , mfn. [ sa. a-prati- rūpa], improper, unsuitable, imfit; m. ~o (ayutto +), Mil 357, 10-27 ; acc. f . ~aṃ (anesanaṃ), DN lll 224, 25 ( = ayuttaṃ, Sv) = SN ll 194, 6 = AN ll 27, 22 = Nidd l 496, 32 ; n. ~aṃ (an-anucchaviyaṃ an-anulomi- kaṃ+), Vin lll 20, 19 (Sp: ananulomikattā ~aṃ) a-ppaṭirūpa attano); Dhp-a lll 5, 22 (~aṃ oḷārikaṃ); Pj l 242, 12 (kāyena~°-karaṇaṃ); Ud-a 16, 23 (°-dese); Pj l 242, 27 (°-vācā-nicchāranaṃ); — ° -tta , n. abstr. , Sp l 219, 31 ( abl. ~ā).
